stories.title: Setup — Quarkus POM, extensions, and application.properties
acceptance_criteria: pom.xml declares quarkus-rest and quarkus-rest-jackson extensions

stories.title: Migrate Greeting REST endpoint from Spring Boot to Quarkus JAX-RS
acceptance_criteria: GET /greeting returns HTTP 200 with JSON { id: long, content: 'Hello, World!' }
GET /greeting?name=Quarkus returns { id: long, content: 'Hello, Quarkus!' }
